attributes.board_name: Iowa Board of Physical and Occupational Therapy (Department of Inspections, Appeals, and Licensing)

rules.accepted_credit_types: No pre-approval of providers; organized programs directly related to PT practice (1 hour = at least 50 minutes; live, virtual, online or prerecorded with proof of completion). Also: APTA-approved residency/fellowship (1 h per 2 h, max 20), clinical education supervision (1 h per 160 h, max 8), presenting (2 h per hour, first offering), academic courses (15 h per semester hour), first-time college teaching, publications (5 h per page), professional organization service (max 4). Business, personal-skills and general health topics (incl. CPR, mandatory reporter training) max 10 hours combined.
rules.new_licensee_rule: No CE required for the first renewal; hours earned from initial licensure to the second renewal may be used.
rules.carryover: Up to 50% of the requirement: max 20 hours into the next renewal period.
rules.audit_note: A percentage of licensees is randomly audited after each renewal cycle; keep certificates (title, dates, contact hours, sponsor, name) for 4 years.
rules.notes: Biennial compliance period runs from the 16th day of the birth month to the 15th day of the birth month two years later. CE must be completed before submitting the renewal. No topic-specific hours in the Board rule.

rules.accepted_credit_types: Same activities as PT (1 hour = at least 50 minutes); clinical education supervision max 4 hours; business, personal-skills and general health topics max 5 hours combined.
rules.new_licensee_rule: No CE required for the first renewal.
rules.carryover: Up to 50% of the requirement: max 10 hours into the next renewal period.
rules.audit_note: Random audit after each renewal cycle; keep certificates 4 years.
rules.notes: Biennial compliance period from the 16th day of the birth month to the 15th day of the birth month two years later.
